segments.en: By day 18, Alex is helping with a growing project. Because the project is growing, Alex needs to explain each step to the team. Before the meeting, Alex reviews "encryption" and "encrypted connection" and explains why each one matters. When a teammate asks for an update, Alex uses "Call an ambulance." and "I need help immediately." to keep the conversation clear. After the meeting, Alex updates the project with "protected branch" and "branch protection rule" and records the next action. The team understands the plan, and Alex has learned to connect vocabulary with real work.
